title: CTAN gives govt final ultimatum, sets November 26 deadline

ai.summary: CTAN demands state government address three issues by November 26, 2026, or risk peaceful agitation.

facts.claim: CTAN has served a final ultimatum to the state government
facts.quote: The Combined Technical Association of Nagaland (CTAN) has served a final ultimatum to the state government

facts.claim: CTAN demands action on three issues by November 26, 2026
facts.quote: demanding action on three issues by November 26, 2026

facts.claim: CTAN warned of democratic and peaceful agitation if demands not met
facts.quote: it warned of democratic and peaceful agitation

ai.background_note: CTAN is a technical association in Nagaland that has been protesting over staff selection board regulations and pay levels.
